name: help-dots
title: Help Dots
description: On the Lists page, Guidance puts pulsing Aldo dots on the page instead of opening the drawer, with a dark button to open Help & Guidance; each dot opens a popover about the thing it marks, one with a screenshot.

sections.label: Band above the Guidance bar
sections.html: Editing dots: drag to move, click to edit

guide.intent: Guidance on a page with dots turns the dots on and raises a band above the Guidance bar. Everyone gets Open Help & Guidance. ESA admins ONLY also get Add Dot and Edit Dots, in a quiet admin inset; a tenant admin sees exactly what a reader sees.
decisions: Roles: Add Dot, Edit Dots, the Need a Spot chip, drafts and every dot editing control are ESA admin only. Dots are ESA-authored help content and identical for every tenant (BCN-1513), so no tenant role authors them.
Every ESA-only control says so in its tooltip ("ESA admin: …"), so the role is legible on the surface, not only in the permission check.
The band rises from behind the bar and fades in (220ms, easing-enter); off, it drops back (160ms, easing-exit). Reduced motion: fades only.
Dots come in at random: each draws a delay (0 to 350ms) and a length (180 to 260ms) on every Guidance-on; pings start once a dot lands.
gotchas: Gate on the ESA admin claim, not on a tenant admin role: a tenant admin must not see Add Dot or Edit Dots.
acceptance: A reader and a tenant admin see only Open Help & Guidance in the band; an ESA admin also sees Add Dot and Edit Dots.

sections.label: On This Page (the dots)
sections.html: On this page

guide.intent: On a page with dots, the drawer's On This Page is the page's published dots in page order. A row closes the drawer, turns dots on, scrolls to the dot and opens it. No page-attached articles are listed here (Related was cut, a deviation from BCN-1513 to settle).
decisions: ESA admin only: drafts with a Draft tag, dots that need a spot (last, muted, alert icon), and hover row tools (Publish, Edit, Dismiss, Pick Again, Detach), each tooltip prefixed "ESA admin:".

Row tools sit in the shared admin cue (src/styles/bcn-admin-cue.css: the settings rail's ESA Admin glass, 22px icon buttons, 14px glyphs) and take their own width, so the text truncates short of them.
acceptance: A tenant admin sees the same list as a reader: published dots only, no tools.

sections.label: Terms
sections.html: Terms

guide.intent: The glossary terms for this page, then the terms it takes from its parent page ("From Project").
decisions: ESA admin only: + Add Term (a typeahead over glossary titles, no tenant aliases exist yet), × to detach a page's own term, and Hide on This Page or Edit on Project for an inherited one. Terms are ESA help content, the same for every tenant (BCN-1513).
acceptance: A tenant admin sees no + and no row tools on Terms.

sections.label: Page header
sections.html:
Lists

Lists are sets of commitments, actions or obligations you want to track and report on together. A commitment can sit on more than one list.

guide.intent: The page name with a map pin, and the page description as plain text under it.
decisions: Tenant admin (and ESA admin): a small pencil at the end of the heading row, tooltip "Edit page description for everyone in <tenant>", opens the description in a side panel. The description is the tenant's own custom rich text (ActionLists on Lists), so this is the one help control a tenant admin has.
acceptance: A tenant admin sees the pencil and no other admin control in the drawer.
